records.title: Flash-SD-KDE: Accelerating SD-KDE with Tensor Cores
records.reason: Flash-SD-KDE reorganizes score-debiased kernel-density computations into matrix multiplication and reports up to 47x speedup on KDE workloads. The application is statistical density estimation, not neural-network inference or serving.

records.title: ZipFlow: a Compiler-based Framework to Unleash Compressed Data Movement for Modern GPUs
records.reason: ZipFlow schedules compressed CPU-to-GPU data movement for columnar Lakehouse analytics and evaluates database-query execution. It does not move model weights/KV state or optimize LLM inference; its linked inference-systems relation is not substantiated by the paper.

records.title: Breaking the Simplification Bottleneck in Amortized Neural Symbolic Regression
records.reason: SimpliPy accelerates symbolic-expression simplification, enabling amortized symbolic-regression training/inference, with a reported 100x speedup over SymPy and test-time compute comparisons. This is a specialized scientific symbolic-regression task, not language-model inference or the linked sparse-attention lineage.

records.title: Federated Inference: Toward Privacy-Preserving Collaborative and Incentivized Model Serving
records.reason: The paper formalizes privacy-preserving collaboration among independently owned models and evaluates an SMPC/ensemble instantiation, discussing non-IID and overhead trade-offs. It is a serving paradigm, but evidence does not show a robust efficiency improvement over standalone inference; retain as a weak inference-systems lead.

records.title: RuleFlow : Generating Reusable Program Optimizations with LLMs
records.reason: RuleFlow converts LLM-discovered per-program Pandas rewrites into reusable compiler rules and reports state-of-the-art results on PandasBench, amortizing repeated LLM calls. Its measured domain is dataframe programs, not model inference kernels or LLM serving; retain only as a weak reusable-optimization/kernel-generation connection.
